post.description: Add or wait list a session to an attendees schedule. One of sessionTimeId or sessionTimeExternalId is required

get.description:
Paged dump of all attendees for an event. Data fields are configurable.
The results of this api are cached for 1 minute.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event code for this api call

parameters.name: attendeeId
parameters.description: Attendee's Id

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: Attendee's External Id

parameters.name: registrationId
parameters.description: Attendee's Registration Id

parameters.name: registered
parameters.description: Attendee's true/false registered state. (supports true/false OR 1/0)

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Attendee's Client Id

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Attendee's email

parameters.name: badgeId
parameters.description: Attendee's Badge Id

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Set the number of results per page of results (default = 1000)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor acts as a type of bookmark for the results list

parameters.name: attributeValueName
parameters.description: Filter the results and only include those with an attribute value with this name

parameters.name: attributeValueCode
parameters.description: Filter the results and only include those with an attribute value with this code

parameters.name: attended
parameters.description: Attendee's true/false attended state. (supports true/false OR 1/0)

parameters.name: checkedIn
parameters.description: Attendee's true/false checked in state. (supports true/false OR 1/0)

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Filters results that are modified since a given timestamp, uses millisecond Unix timestamp (ex. 1749243600000 for June 6th, 2025 at 3:00 PM)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Filters results that are modified before a given timestamp, uses millisecond Unix timestamp (ex. 1749243600000 for June 6th, 2025 at 3:00 PM)

parameters.name: publishedFiles
parameters.description: Allows you to filter down files based on published status, or not.

parameters.name: testAccount
parameters.description: Filter based on test account field. (supports true/false OR 1/0)
